observation.visible_scene: A tranquil forest stream framed by dense, sunlit green trees beneath a pale bright sky. A single rock protrudes from the water left of center, and the lower half of the frame is dominated by mirror-like reflections of the trees and sky (the green masses and white streaks on the water are reflections, not separate objects). Fixed lens-flare artifacts (a greenish blob upper-left, a reddish blob mid-left) overlay the image. A small stretch of white, faster-moving water is visible in the center-right background where the channel narrows.
visible_changes: The water surface shows continuous, gentle ripple motion, causing the reflected trees and sky to shimmer and distort slightly from frame to frame.
The distant white-water flow in the background persists with minor, ongoing turbulence.
The camera framing, the rock's position, the tree silhouettes, and the lens-flare positions remain constant throughout the excerpt; no object enters or exits and no pan/zoom is evident.
The trees and foliage appear essentially still (no clearly resolvable movement).
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the stream's flow rate or direction changes outside this window.
Whether any wind moves the canopy before or after this segment.
The sun position causing the lens flare (the light source itself is not in frame).
uncertain_details: A very slight sway of the treetops cannot be reliably distinguished from video-compression noise.
The exact propagation direction of the surface ripples is hard to confirm from the sampled frames.
